how: Two passes draw each frame. The first traces the world outside: a sky baked from Rayleigh, Mie and ozone scatter, cloud decks and storm towers marched as volumes, towns, roads and airports on the ground, and the wing. The second draws the cabin wall, the recess and three panes of glass, with scratches, frost, rain and the tint of the dimming pane.
The time of day moves one light: the sun by day and twilight, the moon at midnight. The cabin's own lamps follow the 787's mood lighting, and daylight through the window adds to them.

notes.title: Moved to the corners bar
notes.text: Time of day is a stepper top left; Storm and Dim sit in the bottom corners; Cloud, Towns, Rain, Aurora and Sights are in Settings.

notes.title: Seven times of day
notes.text: Dawn, morning, noon, golden hour, dusk, blue hour and midnight. Town lights go out by day.

notes.title: Scratches on the glass
notes.text: Fine hairlines and cleaning swirls catch the cabin light and any bright source.
